detail.title: 4 Channels Penta-brid 1080N/720p Cooper 1U 1SSD 512G WizSense Digital Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite XVR1B04-I(512G) 4 Channels Penta-brid 1080N/720p Cooper 1U 1SSD 512G WizSense Digital Video Recorder Key Points • Preinstall 512GB SSD • 4-ch Analog Video Input, Max. 1080N/720p@30fps Encoding Capability • Max. 5-ch IP Video Input (Up to 2MP) • AI Functions: 4-ch SMD, 4-ch AI Coding Sales Enquiry Datasheet

SMD Plus.SMD Plus by Recorder: 4-channel: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle , reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

Audio and Video.IP Camera Input: Up to 5 channels of IPC access. 1 IP channel by default + 4 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) incoming bandwidth: 20 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 20 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 20 Mbps *After IP channels are added beyond the existing channels, the AI Function (SMD) will be disabled.
Audio and Video.Encoding Capacity: Main stream: All channel 1080N@ (1–25/30 fps);720p@(1–25/30 fps); 960H@ (1–25/30 fps); D1@ (1–25/30 fps); CIF@ (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream: CIF@ (1–15 fps)
Audio and Video.Video Frame Rate: PAL: 1 fps/s–25 fps/s NTSC: 1 fps/s–30 fps/s
Audio and Video.Multi-screen Display: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/6
Audio and Video.Third-party Camera Access: ONVIF; Panasonic; Sony; Axis; Arecont; Samsung

Network.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; RTSP; UDP; SMTP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; P2P
Network.Interoperability: ONVIF 22.06 (Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK

Recording Playback.Playback Mode: Instant playback, general playback, event playback, tag playback, smart playback (motion detection)

Alarm.General Alarm: Motion detection; camera external alarm; network alarm; PIR alarm
Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk, disk error, low space, low quota space; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict); video loss; video tampering; camera offline
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); IPC external alarm output; voice prompt; buzzer; log; preset; email

Ports.Two-way Talk: Yes (share the same audio input with the first channel)
Ports.HDD Interface: 1 SSD: 512 GB (replaceable with 256 GB or 1 TB) Stores for 22 days under default settings.

General.Certifications: CE: CE-LVD: EN 60950-1/IEC 60950-1 CE-EMC: EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 55032, EN 50130, EN 55024 FCC: Part 15 Subpart B
